 Many might be wondering, does the dog pass away in this movie?
 It's been a growing conversation over the years on the Internet. She gave some assurance to the audience in a recent interview.
 Anne Hathaway shares her opinion on dogs dying in movies
 "I feel like movies that kill dogs should automatically be rated R. It doesn't matter if anybody curses, it doesn't matter if there's violence…if a dog dies, it's R-rated," Anne said in an interview with Complex .
 Does the dog die in The End of Oak Street ?
 The dog does NOT die in The End of Oak Street !
